Dear Sir/Madam, 
Sub: Audio recording of earnings call – Q1 FY27 – Financial Results 
We refer to our intimation dated July 2, 2026 informing about the conference call to be hosted by the 
Company on July 15, 2026 to discuss the financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. 
In this connection, pursuant to the provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, the Company has conducted Q1 FY27 Earnings Call today i.e. July 15, 2026, and have

https://www.hdfcfund.com/about-us/financial/shareholders-presentation
